title: Strategic Account Management
overview: Strategic Account Management equips professionals to build long-term, profitable partnerships with strategically important customers. The program moves beyond routine account servicing to account portfolio prioritization, business insight, executive alignment, value co-creation, competitive positioning, and multi-year growth planning. Participants learn to evaluate account potential, map decision networks, formulate differentiated account strategies, lead cross-functional account teams, and govern performance through measurable customer and commercial outcomes.
audience: Strategic and key account managers responsible for high-value customer relationships.
Sales directors, business development managers, and commercial leaders.
Client relationship managers, enterprise sales professionals, and customer success leaders.
Account team leaders and professionals managing complex B2B or institutional accounts.
methodology: Interactive facilitator-led sessions combine strategic account case studies, customer portfolio analysis, stakeholder mapping workshops, account-planning templates, financial and opportunity assessments, negotiation scenarios, executive meeting simulations, peer feedback, and a capstone strategic account plan. Participants apply each tool to a realistic or current priority account.
competencies: Strategic account selection, segmentation, and portfolio prioritization.
Customer business analysis and industry intelligence.
Stakeholder mapping, executive relationship building, and influence.
Account strategy formulation and value proposition development.
Commercial planning, negotiation, risk management, and growth forecasting.
Account performance measurement and continuous improvement.
objectives: Differentiate strategic account management from transactional selling and routine account servicing.
Select strategic accounts using objective attractiveness, fit, and growth criteria.
Analyze customer priorities, economics, buying structures, and competitive dynamics.
Build influence across decision-makers, sponsors, users, and procurement stakeholders.
Develop a differentiated, customer-centered strategic account plan.
Identify white-space opportunities and design value-creation initiatives.
Coordinate internal resources to deliver a consistent account experience.
Manage commercial risk, profitability, negotiations, and account retention.
Establish meaningful account KPIs, review routines, and improvement actions.
